metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Discovery Protocol
metadata.description: Discovery protocol enabling autonomous AI agents to locate, interpret, and initialize FFT AI Edition modules, substrates, and capabilities.

discovery_profile.notes: This protocol defines how agents discover FFT modules, resolve dependencies, and activate conceptual capabilities.

discovery_sequence.name: Locate Manifest
discovery_sequence.description: Agent identifies the canonical manifest to understand directory structure.

discovery_sequence.name: Load Registry
discovery_sequence.description: Agent loads the module registry to enumerate available FFT modules.

discovery_sequence.name: Initialize Core
discovery_sequence.description: Agent loads the minimal FFT core to establish baseline conceptual primitives.

discovery_sequence.name: Load Full Specification
discovery_sequence.description: Agent loads the full FFT specification to access structures, types, and validation profiles.

discovery_sequence.name: Load Substrate
discovery_sequence.description: Agent loads the hardware-ready conceptual substrate.

discovery_sequence.name: Bind Hardware Profile
discovery_sequence.description: Agent binds hardware capability profile to substrate and spec.

discovery_sequence.name: Activate Bootstrap
discovery_sequence.description: Agent activates the FFT bootstrap sequence for runtime initialization.

discovery_events.description: Triggered when an FFT module is successfully loaded.
Triggered when a hardware kernel becomes available.
Triggered when a validation profile is activated.
